description: Save post text as a named template for reuse (text only; media and channels belong to the post). Up to 200 per organization per kind (captions and first-comment snippets each have their own 200); names are unique per kind, so a caption and a first-comment snippet can share a name. Use this when the user wants to save post text for reuse.

kind.description: What the text is for: a post caption, or a first-comment reply. Defaults to caption.

name: create_template
title: Create post template
